title: Cube Bench: A Benchmark for Spatial Visual Reasoning in MLLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the absolute difference between the 'Yes' prediction rate and 0.5 (|Yes rate - 0.5|) in a balanced Yes/No cross-modal verification task to measure systematic defaults to affirmative answers.
Evaluating and mitigating the tendency of models to favor specific multiple-choice letters by tracking per-slot frequencies and uniformly shuffling A-D answer options.
Using chance-corrected Cohen's kappa (κ) in causal move-effect predictions to adjust for skewed prediction mixes (e.g., models over-predicting 'INCREASE') and depth-dependent label distributions.
